title: Thanksgiving airfares jump 57% to $469 as US families switch to road trips amid flight disruptions
summary_full: Thanksgiving travel in the U.S. faces challenges as airfare skyrockets and recent technical malfunctions plague airlines. With average ticket prices hitting $469, families like Dinese Jackson are reconsidering flying altogether, opting for long drives instead. Additionally, the Federal Aviation Administration has issued warnings about potential storm disruptions during the travel week. Nevertheless, airlines are gearing up to accommodate millions of holiday travelers this Thanksgiving.
